# AI Receptionist Go‑to‑Market (GTM) – Tech Doc Checklist

**Version:** 1.0  
**Owner:** ________  
**Last Updated:** ________  
**Timeframe:** First 12 months (with 90‑day sprint plan)  

---

## 0) Objectives & Guardrails
- [ ] **Primary Objective:** Achieve product‑market fit in Real Estate (solo agents & small teams) and reach $5k MRR in 6 months.  
- [ ] **Secondary Objective:** Build repeatable demand gen + onboarding motion to support vertical expansion (Law, Agencies, Healthcare, Financial Advisors).  
- [ ] **Strategy Guardrails:** Broad weekly reach; continuity over bursts; focus on mental + physical availability; measure medians with error bars; avoid “gee‑whiz” charts and spurious causality.  

**North‑Star KPIs**
- [ ] Paying customers (count) & MRR  
- [ ] Signup → Live widget install rate ≥ 80%  
- [ ] Time to First Qualified Lead (TTFQL) ≤ 48 hours  
- [ ] Trial → Paid conversion (Day 14) 25–35%  
- [ ] Monthly churn < 5%  
- [ ] Weekly reach (impressions/unique reach) without dark weeks  

---

## 1) Job‑to‑Be‑Done & Positioning
**Deliverable:** Vertical value prop grid
- [ ] Draft master positioning: *“Industry‑trained 24/7 AI receptionist that qualifies leads, books meetings, and syncs to your CRM.”*  
- [ ] Identify Category Entry Points (CEPs) per vertical (e.g., **after‑hours**, **too many tire‑kickers**, **first response time**, **calendar coordination**).  
- [ ] Build **Value Prop Grid** per vertical (template in Appendix A): 3 CEPs, top integrations, 1 ROI proof point to validate.  
- [ ] Validate language via 5 discovery interviews (agents) and update copy deck.  

**Owner:** PMM  
**Due:** Week 1  
**Artifacts:** Value prop grid, copy deck, interview notes  

---

## 2) Distinctive Brand Assets (DBAs)
**Deliverable:** 1‑page DBA spec applied across all touchpoints
- [ ] Lock assets: name, logomark, high‑contrast color, sonic cue (≤2 sec), motion bumper (≤1 sec).  
- [ ] Create **DBA spec** (logo spacing, do’s/don’ts, tone lines).  
- [ ] Run **24‑hour fluency test** (n≈15 target buyers): forced/unaided recall; adjust if <70% recognition.  
- [ ] Implement in site, widget, ads, video bumpers, decks.  

**Owner:** Brand Lead  
**Due:** Week 2  
**Artifacts:** DBA spec PDF, asset kit (SVG, PNG, MP3), motion bumper  

---

## 3) Physical Availability & Pricing
**Deliverables:** Install flow, plans, 2‑minute setup video
- [ ] **Install:** 1‑line embed snippet; 10‑min guided setup; “click‑to‑enable” CRM/Calendar integrations.  
- [ ] **Plans:** Starter $99, Pro $299 (caps aligned to COGS); optional overage; free trial 14 days.  
- [ ] **Trial Aid:** “First 200 conversations free” mechanic (non‑discount).  
- [ ] **How‑to:** Publish 2‑minute install video; add live demo bot on homepage.  
- [ ] Track **Signup → Live widget** (target ≥80%).  

**Owner:** Product + Growth Eng  
**Due:** Week 3  
**Artifacts:** Embed snippet, setup wizard, pricing page, install video

- [ ] Confirm ICP: solo agents & small teams (20–50 inbound leads/mo).

## 9) Measurement & Reporting Plan
**Deliverable:** Metric dictionary + dashboards
- [ ] Define each KPI (Appendix B) incl. **metric name, formula, median vs mean, CI method, sampling**.  
- [ ] Build dashboards: *Penetration, Mental Availability, Physical Availability, Financial*.  
- [ ] Add **weekly** and **monthly** reporting cadences; include **sample sizes** and avoid truncated axes.

## 10) Experimentation Roadmap (2–3 Tests/Month)
**Deliverable:** Pre‑registered test briefs
- [ ] **Pricing A/B:** $99/$299 vs $129/$279; evaluate conversion + 60‑day retention (report medians + CI).  
- [ ] **CEP Messaging A/B:** “After‑hours lead capture” vs “Qualify tire‑kickers”; measure recall + trial starts.  
- [ ] **Install Assist A/B:** DIY vs Concierge Install; goal: Signup → Live ≥ 80%.  
- [ ] Maintain registry: hypothesis, design, sample size, decision rule, owner, due date, results.  

**Owner:** PMM + Growth  
**Due:** Start Week 5; monthly cycles  
**Artifacts:** Test briefs, result readouts, decision log

## 13) Risk Controls
**Deliverables:** Monthly risk review
- [ ] **AI cost risk:** multi‑provider switcher, usage caps; plan economics review monthly.  
- [ ] **Acquisition softness:** lean on always‑on search + webinars + partner swaps; free trial hygiene.  
- [ ] **Competitive moves:** double down on industry templates, integrations, content moat.  
- [ ] **Data/privacy:** document data flow, DPA templates, SOC2 roadmap.  

**Owner:** Ops + Security + Finance  
**Due:** Ongoing

- [ ] Landing page live with **live demo** widget.  

### Weeks 2–4
- [ ] Search campaigns live; founder LI outbound cadence active.  
- [ ] Weekly webinar scheduled + promoted.  
- [ ] Concierge Install launched; install guide shipped.  
- [ ] Dashboards v1 live (activation + funnel).  

### Weeks 5–8
- [ ] 10–20 paying customers; first Real Estate case study video.  
- [ ] First CRM co‑marketing (blog/newsletter) published.  
- [ ] Experiment 1–2 launched (pricing, CEP messaging).  

### Weeks 9–12

- [ ] Pricing A/B readout + decision.

# KPI Dashboard Spec (What to Track)

## Penetration
- [ ] Paying customers by vertical  
- [ ] % customers with **live widget**  

## Mental Availability
- [ ] DBA recognition (prompted/unaided)  
- [ ] Ad recall & CEP association (survey panel)  

## Physical Availability
- [ ] Signup → Live widget install rate  
- [ ] Integration attach rate  
- [ ] Search share / rank of category queries  

## Financial
- [ ] CAC payback (blended)  
- [ ] Gross margin by plan (track COGS per conversation)  
- [ ] Net revenue retention  

**Reporting Cadence**
- [ ] Weekly: reach, site sessions, signup→live rate, TTFQL  
- [ ] Monthly: trial→paid, churn, cohort retention, GM%, CAC payback  
- [ ] Quarterly: brand/CEP survey, share of search

## Appendix B: Metric Dictionary (Examples)
- **TTFQL (hrs):** median hours from “go live” → first lead labeled Qualified.  
- **Install Rate:** signups with live widget within 7 days / total signups.  
- **Integration Attach Rate:** % of live accounts with ≥1 CRM/calendar connected.  
- **Ad Recall (prompted):** % who recall brand after exposure; measured via panel.  
- **Gross Margin (plan‑level):** (Revenue − COGS conversations − infra) / Revenue.  

---

## Appendix C: Lifecycle Email Outlines
- **Day 0 – Install Now**: 3‑step setup + 2‑minute video + concierge offer.  
- **Day 2 – Capture After‑Hours Leads**: enable template; highlight booked meetings.  
- **Day 7 – Integrate Your CRM**: “click‑to‑enable”; share one customer quote.
